How can I extract text from a PDF that has copy protection? Provide technical details and code examples.

To extract text from copy-protected PDFs, you can use OCR (Optical Character Recognition) tools. Steps: 1) Convert PDF pages to images using tools like pdf2image, 2) Use Tesseract OCR to extract text from images. Example code: from pdf2image import convert_from_path; pages = convert_from_path('protected.pdf'); for page in pages: text = pytesseract.image_to_string(page); print(text). This method bypasses copy protection by treating the content as images.
